name: eliteboards-workspace
description: EliteBoards full-stack real-time leaderboard platform (Web, Mobile, Server)

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:web
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.test:mobile: npm --prefix mobile/eliteboards-mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile/eliteboards-mobile run check-config && npm --prefix mobile/eliteboards-mobile run doctor
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['client/Leaderboard/dist', 'mobile/eliteboards-mobile/dist'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); }); console.log('Cleaned build artifacts.');"
